description.value: Once per day, when you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points, you may choose to consume it outright instead of simply defeating it. A creature consumed this way cannot be restored to life, healed, or raised by anything short of a true divine intervention. When you do, you immediately regain all spent Zeal and gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level, lasting 1 hour. Something that used to be a person is now, entirely and permanently, food.
